stance: C2PA is maintaining an incremental technical cadence, advancing its origin-certification standards without any indicated shift in market momentum.
adoption_shape: Movement is confined entirely to the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity itself, which progressed from version 2.4 to 2.5 without any reported change in member or third-party positions.
new_entrants: No new participants arrived in this update, leaving governance solely with the existing coalition maintaining the open standards library.
watch_for: Evidence of whether version 2.5 is implemented by industry systems or remains limited to the organization's specification repository.
